review.notes: Reviewed every take by contact strip. The walk keeps its published version. Attack and death were retaken with steady light because the first attack strobed dark and the first death went dark twice mid-fall. The defend is retaken with room above for the raised staff and ends on the held guard. The censer swing darkened the chanter into a silhouette in two takes, so the ranged is retaken telling the chanter to stay lit with no smoke from the censer. Idle, hit and cast are first takes.
